name: Kusakabe Yuuki
source:
Yuuki is a mysterious girl that [url=/c15061]Takaaki[/url] meets in school at night, and for some reason she is not usually seen. She carries around a notebook called the "Trash Basket Notebook".

[spoiler]Yuuki used to be Takaaki's classmate in elementary school, but after her parents divorced her last name was changed from Takashiro to Kusakabe, and she had to transfer to a different school.[/spoiler]

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_To_Heart_series_characters#To_Heart_2]Wikipedia[/url]]
